The '''Lovola system''' was located in the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Rim Route]] to the Rifle Worlds' [[Maires system/Legends|Maires system]] as well as the [[Ket system/Legends|Ket system]] in the [[Lorelli Reach]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Lovola [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Lovolan]] company.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|47|MAN 5-6|Droid Manufacturers}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Lovolan]]|system=Lovola [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lovola system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
